theorems.name: Submission.lpf_raf_local_lipschitz_area
theorems.statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω D : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (w : Eucl n → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → D ⊆ Ω → NullMeasurableSet D (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → AEMeasurable w ((volume : Measure (Eucl n)).restrict D) → AEMeasurable (fun y => ∑' x : {x : Eucl n // x ∈ D ∧ u x = y}, w x) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) ∧ ∫⁻ x in D, w x * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n)) = ∫⁻ y, ∑' x : {x : Eucl n // x ∈ D ∧ u x = y}, w x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
